checks: Typing is batched and immediate reload preserves the last input without a recovery screen.
Correcting an invalid answer clears its error and invalid state.
Clicking an option takes precedence over stale typed choice text.
Enter on Edit previous answer activates that button instead of submitting the form.
Unsent text survives editing an earlier answer and then reloading.
A queued write, later typing, and Cancel cannot overwrite or delete a newer draft after a cross-tab conflict.
Cancel clears the pending autosave and does not recreate a discarded draft.
Editing a complete saved setup opens its prefilled Project setup form.
